title: GitHub - faizannraza/wattage: A token-spend profiler and cost-regression gate for AI agents.
excerpt: A token-spend profiler and cost-regression gate for AI agents. - faizannraza/wattage
content_html:
A Kill-A-Watt meter for your AI agents. Point it at a trace and it tells you exactly where your tokens are being burned and wasted, prices each waste pattern in real dollars, prescribes a fix, and can fail your CI when a change makes your agent measurably more expensive.

A real captured agent trace (see provenance) — Wattage catches a stable prompt prefix being re-sent instead of cached, prices the waste, and prescribes the fix. Regenerate this GIF with vhs docs/assets/demo.tape (see the tape file for the exact command).

Install and run

uvx wattage report trace.json

No config file, no API key, fully offline — point it at an OTLP JSON trace export and it prices every call and runs every detector. Don't have a trace yet? Getting your first trace covers both "I already have OTel traces" and "I have zero instrumentation" (a runnable, 5-minute path from nothing to a real, priced report). Or try it right now against the fixture shipped in this repo:

git clone https://github.com/faizannraza/wattage
cd wattage && uv sync
uv run wattage report examples/sample_trace.json
╭──── ⚡ wattage — examples/sample_trace.json ────╮
│ Token Efficiency: A (100)   Total cost: $0.0602 │
│ quality: unmeasured                             │
╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
      Token breakdown
┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┳━━━━━━━━┓
┃ Category       ┃ Tokens ┃
┡━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━╇━━━━━━━━┩
│ input          │  18450 │
│ output         │    320 │
│ cache_read     │      0 │
│ cache_creation │      0 │
│ reasoning      │      0 │
└────────────────┴────────┘
No findings — this trace looks efficient.
pricing: 2026-07-18-verified

Or get a self-contained, shareable HTML flame graph instead of the terminal view:

uv run wattage report examples/sample_trace.json --html report.html

The evidence, not a marketing claim

Wattage's standout feature is the convergence engine — the nonconvergence detector, which catches an agent thrashing through a loop without making real progress, including patterns a naive exact-match duplicate detector structurally cannot see (a retry with a fresh timestamp each time, an oscillation between two strategies, a "productive-looking" stall where every call is technically unique but nothing is actually learned).

Rather than assert that, we built a hand-reviewed set of 10 labeled synthetic loops and benchmarked Wattage's classifier against a real SHA-256 exact-match baseline implementation:

Classifier Precision Recall F1
Wattage 1.00 1.00 1.00
SHA-256 exact-match 1.00 0.14 0.25

Reproduce it yourself — no cherry-picking, no hidden setup:

uv run python -m benchmarks.harness

And on a genuine captured agent trace (not synthetic — see benchmarks/traces/README.md for provenance), Wattage's prefix_churn fix simulation shows a 44.7% cost reduction ($0.000199 → $0.000110) from enabling prompt caching on the stable prefix — small dollar figures because it's a 3-turn demo trace, but the mechanism is identical at production scale. Run it against your own traces for numbers that matter:

uv run python -c "from benchmarks.frontier import build_frontier; print(build_frontier())"

Full methodology: The Convergence Engine.

The badge

uv run wattage badge trace.json --out wattage-badge.svg
![Wattage](wattage-badge.svg)

Wire --badge-out into your CI job (see below) so it regenerates on every merge to your default branch, and the badge in your README stays live.

How it works

Three surfaces, one normalized data model underneath (sessions → tasks → loops → iterations → calls), built from OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention traces:

  • wattage report — ingests a trace, prices every call against a vendored, dated pricing snapshot, and runs eight detectors:

    Detector Catches
    prefix_churn Stable context re-sent instead of cached
    cache_gap Caching attempted but under-redeemed by later reads
    verbosity Output far beyond what the step needed
    redundant_tool_calls The same tool call repeated (exact or fuzzy)
    nonconvergence Loops that thrash, oscillate, or stall without progress
    retrieval_thrash Repeated retrieval that never yields relevant results
    model_mismatch A pricier model doing work a cheaper one could handle
    reasoning_overspend Heavy reasoning-token spend on a simple step

    Every finding is priced in real dollars, includes a concrete fix, and is tagged with a quality_risk tier (none / low / review) — a fix that could plausibly change output quality (a model downgrade, less reasoning) only counts toward your score once a --quality map backs it with real evidence. Full detail: Detectors.

  • wattage score / wattage badge — a single 0–100 Token Efficiency grade for a README badge or a CI gate.

  • wattage ci — the cost-regression gate (below).

Wattage never fabricates a number: an unpriced model leaves that call's cost at zero (and fails wattage ci loudly, exit code 4) rather than guessing; an unmeasured quality signal is reported as unmeasured, not assumed fine.

CI integration

# .github/workflows/wattage.yml
name: Wattage
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ["agents/**", "prompts/**", "src/**"]
concurrency:
  group: wattage-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  token-efficiency:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Generate trace fixture
        run: python scripts/run_agent_fixture.py > trace.json
      - name: Wattage cost-regression gate
        uses: faizannraza/wattage/action@v0.1.0
        with:
          source: trace.json
          baseline: .wattage/baseline.json
          fail-on: "score_below:80,cost_delta_pct_above:5,any_critical:true"
          pr-comment: "true"

Fails the build (exit code 1) when your agent regresses past the threshold you set, posts a per-detector delta table as a PR comment, and emits SARIF (shows up in GitHub's Security tab) and JUnit XML for any other CI system. The baseline is a small committed JSON file — noise-floor protection is structural, not statistical: it only ever updates on a run that actually passed the gate.

This is only half the setup. A PR job runs on a throwaway checkout, so it can't be the thing that updates .wattage/baseline.json on disk — that update needs a second workflow, triggered on push to your default branch, that commits the refreshed baseline (and badge) back after each merge. Skipping it means every PR compares against the same stale baseline forever. Full reference, with both workflows: CI Integration.

Contributing

Detectors are discovered through a Python entry-point group, so adding one doesn't require touching this repo's core pipeline — see CONTRIBUTING.md for the full "write a detector" walkthrough, using cache_gap as the reference example.

blocks.html_en: Fails the build (exit code 1) when your agent regresses past the threshold you set, posts a per-detector delta table as a PR comment, and emits SARIF (shows up in GitHub's Security tab) and JUnit XML for any other CI system. The baseline is a small committed JSON file — noise-floor protection is structural, not statistical: it only ever updates on a run that actually passed the gate.

blocks.html_en: This is only half the setup. A PR job runs on a throwaway checkout, so it can't be the thing that updates .wattage/baseline.json on disk — that update needs a second workflow, triggered on push to your default branch, that commits the refreshed baseline (and badge) back after each merge. Skipping it means every PR compares against the same stale baseline forever. Full reference, with both workflows: CI Integration.

content_html_zh:
为您的 AI 代理提供的 Kill-A-Watt 计量表。 将其指向一个痕迹，它会准确地告诉您代币在哪里被烧毁和浪费，以实际美元对每种浪费模式进行定价，规定修复方案，并且当更改使您的代理成本明显更高时，它可能会导致您的 CI 失败。

真实捕获的代理跟踪（请参阅出处） - Wattage 捕获重新发送而不是缓存的稳定提示前缀，对浪费进行定价，并规定修复方法。 使用 vhs docs/assets/demo.tape 重新生成此 GIF（有关确切命令，请参阅磁带文件）。

安装并运行

uvx wattage report trace.json

没有配置文件，没有 API 密钥，完全离线 - 将其指向 OTLP JSON 跟踪导出，它会对每次调用进行定价并运行每个检测器。 还没有踪迹吗？ 获取您的第一个跟踪涵盖“我已经有 OTel 跟踪”和“我有零仪器”（从无到真实、定价报告的可运行的 5 分钟路径）。 或者立即针对此存储库中提供的固定装置进行尝试：

git clone https://github.com/faizannraza/wattage
cd wattage && uv sync
uv run wattage report examples/sample_trace.json

或者获取一个独立的、可共享的 HTML 火焰图而不是终端视图：

uv run wattage report examples/sample_trace.json --html report.html

证据，而非营销主张

Wattage 的突出功能是收敛引擎 - 非收敛检测器，它捕获代理在循环中颠簸而没有取得真正的进展，包括简单的精确匹配重复检测器在结构上无法看到的模式（每次使用新时间戳重试，两种策略之间的振荡，一个“富有成效的”停顿，其中每个调用在技术上都是唯一的，但实际上没有学到任何东西）。

我们并没有断言这一点，而是构建了一组手工审查的 10 个标记的合成循环，并根据真实的 SHA-256 精确匹配基线实现对 Wattage 的分类器进行了基准测试：

分类器 精确 记起 F1
瓦数 1.00 1.00 1.00
SHA-256 完全匹配 1.00 0.14 0.25

自己复制——没有挑选，没有隐藏设置：

uv run python -m benchmarks.harness

在真正捕获的代理跟踪（不是合成的 — 请参阅 benchmarks/traces/README.md 了解出处）上，Wattage 的 prefix_churn 修复模拟显示，在稳定前缀上启用提示缓存可降低 44.7% 的成本（0.000199 美元 → 0.000110 美元）——小美元数字，因为它是 3 轮演示跟踪，但该机制在生产规模上是相同的。 根据您自己的痕迹运行它以获取重要的数字：

uv run python -c "from benchmarks.frontier import build_frontier; print(build_frontier())"

完整的方法论：融合引擎。

徽章

uv run wattage badge trace.json --out wattage-badge.svg
![Wattage](wattage-badge.svg)

将 --badge-out 连接到您的 CI 作业（见下文），以便它在每次合并到默认分支时重新生成，并且 README 中的徽章保持有效。

它是如何运作的

三个表面，下面一个标准化数据模型（会话 → 任务 → 循环 → 迭代 → 调用），根据 OpenTelemetry GenAI 语义约定跟踪构建：

  • 瓦数报告 — 摄取跟踪，根据供应商、日期定价快照对每个调用进行定价，并运行 8 个检测器： 检测器 捕获 prefix_churn 重新发送的稳定上下文，而不是缓存的 cache_gap 已尝试缓存，但稍后读取未充分兑现 冗长 输出远远超出步骤所需的内容 Redundant_tool_calls 相同的工具调用重复（精确或模糊）非收敛 剧烈、振荡或停滞而无进展的循环retrieval_thrash 重复检索，永远不会产生相关结果 model_mismatch 价格较高的模型做工作，便宜的模型可以处理 Reasoning_overspend 在一个简单的步骤上花费大量的推理令牌每项发现都以实际美元定价，包括具体的修复，并标记有质量风险层（无/低/审查）——一个可能合理地改变输出质量（模型降级，更少推理）的修复只有在 --quality 地图用真实证据支持它时才会计入你的分数。 完整细节：探测器。
  • 瓦数分数/瓦数徽章 — README 徽章或 CI 门的单个 0-100 令牌效率等级。
  • 瓦数 ci — 成本回归门（如下）。

瓦数从不编造数字：未定价的模型使通话成本为零（并且大声失败瓦数 ci，退出代码 4）而不是猜测；未测量的质量信号被报告为未测量，而不是假设良好。

CI集成

# .github/workflows/wattage.yml
name: Wattage
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ["agents/**", "prompts/**", "src/**"]
concurrency:
  group: wattage-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  token-efficiency:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Generate trace fixture
        run: python scripts/run_agent_fixture.py > trace.json
      - name: Wattage cost-regression gate
        uses: faizannraza/wattage/action@v0.1.0
        with:
          source: trace.json
          baseline: .wattage/baseline.json
          fail-on: "score_below:80,cost_delta_pct_above:5,any_critical:true"
          pr-comment: "true"

当您的代理回归超过您设置的阈值时，构建失败（退出代码 1），将每个检测器增量表作为 PR 评论发布，并为任何其他 CI 系统发出 SARIF（显示在 GitHub 的安全选项卡中）和 JUnit XML。 基线是一个小的提交的 JSON 文件——本底噪声保护是结构性的，而不是统计性的：它只在实际通过门的运行上更新。

这只是设置的一半。 PR 作业在一次性签出上运行，因此它不可能更新磁盘上的 .wattage/baseline.json - 该更新需要第二个工作流程，在推送到默认分支时触发，在每次合并后提交刷新的基线（和徽章）。 跳过它意味着每个 PR 都会永远与相同的陈旧基线进行比较。 包含两个工作流程的完整参考：CI 集成。

贡献

检测器是通过 Python 入口点组发现的，因此添加检测器不需要接触此存储库的核心管道 - 请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md 以获取完整的“编写检测器”演练，并使用 cache_gap 作为参考示例。
